Assess alternatives on identical inputs and outputs: explicit derived-law bundles versus immutable parent-plus-transformation laws. Require the same governing measure, dependency closure, information lineage and failure behavior. Do not demand implementation of the deferred lazy evaluator or infer superiority from inspectability.

Produce one structured independent review response with exact file/record locators, checked calculations, assumptions, unresolved findings and next actions. The supervisor retains it through the ordinary review workflow. Reviewers remain read-only and add no modules or prose-certification tests. Stop when the bounded review yields AGREE with issues=[] or REVISE with actionable material findings. AGREE covers this uncertainty group only. A material mismatch triggers a separate narrowly scoped repair plan; do not repair during review or begin accounting work. Follow the supplied monotonic clock before substantial batches and after checks; if time ends, identify the exact unreviewed subsection without claiming acceptance.
